title: Componentwise section of cartesian extension-by-zero exchange
statement: Let ℓ be prime, k a field of positive prime characteristic different from ℓ, and Λ a commutative condensed ring. Let X, Z, Xprime and Zprime be separated finite-type k-schemes, with k-morphisms j:X→Z, g:Zprime→Z, jprime:Xprime→Zprime and gprime:Xprime→X forming a cartesian square; assume j and jprime are open immersions. Use the bounded constructible functors of [sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors] and the unit-square-counit exchange formula of [def-sfb-dc-open-base-change-morphism]. Let α be a natural transformation gprime^* ⋙ jprime_! → j_! ⋙ g^* equal to this explicit formula. For every bounded constructible Λ_X-module complex K, there exists a morphism β_K from the target of α_K to its source such that β_K ≫ α_K is the identity on the target. No naturality in K is assumed or data chosen.

proof.text: Reuse the proved boundedCartesianCounit helper in the proof module of [stage3-sfb-open-base-change-component-mono]. It says that the bounded-constructible jprime counit is invertible at g^*(j_! K). Its proof uses ordinary abelian-sheaf cartesian base change to detect support, reflects the linear counit through Mod.forget, derives the resulting natural isomorphism, and restricts through the fully faithful bounded-constructible inclusion. No equality of module and abelian exchange maps is required.

Reuse the proved sharedBoundedOpenUnitIsIso helper from the proof module of [stage3-sfb-open-base-change-component-mono]. This derives the open-immersion unit isomorphism from condensed recollement and restricts the fully faithful derived extension by zero to bounded constructible objects. It supplies invertibility of the exact bounded-constructible adjunction unit appearing in the exchange formula.

Rewrite alpha by h_alpha and expand only natural-transformation composition and whiskering at K. Every factor is invertible: the unit from step 2, the square-transport isomorphism, the counit from step 1, and the unitors. Hence alpha.app K is invertible. Its inverse beta satisfies beta composed with alpha.app K = identity by IsIso.inv_hom_id.

proof_origin.place: P3 quarantine restoration: reuse boundedCartesianCounit and sharedBoundedOpenUnitIsIso from ExchangeMono; expand the original exchange component and use its categorical inverse. All statements and the unit route are preserved.

lean.statement:
theorem boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChange_app_section
    (sq : IsPullback g' j' j g)
    (α : boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g' ⋙
        boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j' ⟶
      boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j ⋙
        boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g)
    (hα : α =
      ((Functor.leftUnitor _).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight
        (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction Λ ℓ j).unit
        (boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g' ⋙
          boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j')) ≫
      (Functor.squareTransport (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j)
        (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j')
        (boundedConstructiblePullbackSquareComparison Λ ℓ sq.toCommSq.flip)).hom ≫
      (Functor.whiskerLeft
        (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j ⋙
          boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g)
        (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction Λ ℓ j').counit ≫
        (Functor.rightUnitor _).hom))
    (K : Dᵇc(X.left)⟦Λ⟧) :
    ∃ β : (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j ⋙
        boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g).obj K ⟶
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g' ⋙
        boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j').obj K,
      β ≫ α.app K = 𝟙 _
